How to create sssd.conf for an IPA domain
output:
cat > /etc/sssd/sssd.conf << 'EOF'
[sssd]
domains = ipa.example.com
services = nss, pam

[domain/ipa.example.com]
id_provider = ipa
auth_provider = ipa
ipa_server = ipa.example.com
ipa_domain = ipa.example.com
EOF
